headline: Approved Varney Aviation lease, entered executive session, and approved real estate sales at 45 Allen Street and 299 Essex Street
summary: The committee discussed a proposed lease between Varney Aviation and Bangor International Airport, and economic development initiatives including Venture Forward with the Roux Institute and an AI Hub partnership with the University of Maine. The committee moved to staff recommendation on the airport lease, entered executive session to discuss two real property or economic development items, and then moved to staff recommendation on the sales of 45 Allen Street and 299 Essex Street.
decisions: Moved to staff recommendation on the proposed lease with Varney Aviation at Bangor International Airport.
Voted to enter Executive Session for two items under 1 M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(C) regarding acquisition of real property or economic development.
Moved staff recommendation on the sales for 45 Allen Street and 299 Essex Street.

decision_evidence.quote: Councilor Carson moved to staff recommendation. Seconded by Councilor Faloon. Vote unless doubted, no doubt.

Councilor Carson moved that, pursuant to 1 M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(C) Acquisition of Real Property or Economic Development, there are two items to enter into Executive Session. Seconded by Council Faloon. Roll call vote conducted – all in favor, none opposed. Motion passed
Councilor Carson moved staff recommendation on the sales for 45 Allen Street and 299 Essex Street. Seconded by Councilor Faloon. Vote unless doubted, no doubt.

plain_text:
BUSINESS & ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMITTEE
Monday, July 6, 2026 @ 5:15 PM
Council Chambers, First Floor of City Hall
MEETING MINUTES
City Councilors Present: Leonard, Faloon, Mallar, Fish, Carson,
Beck, Walker, Hawes, Deane
City Staff Present: Krieg, Lear
Chair Leonard called the meeting to order at 5:27 P.M.
1. Proposed Lease with Bangor International Airport
A. Varney Aviation
Chair Leonard introduced the agenda item.
Assistant Airport Director Francis Robbins presented on the proposed lease.
Chair Leonard expressed he had no issues with the proposed lease, and asked for input
or questions.
Councilor Mallar asked if the City’s Legal Department reviewed the lease – Assistant
Airport Director Robbins confirmed the City drafted the initial lease. 
Councilor Carson moved to staff recommendation. Seconded by Councilor Faloon. Vote
unless doubted, no doubt. 
2. Economic Development Initiatives
A. Venture Forward with the Roux Institute
B. AI Hub Partner
Chair Leonard introduced the agenda item.
Community and Economic Development Director Krieg presented on the Venture Forward
with the Roux Institute partnership, outlining the goals to increase the Institute’s
entrepreneurship program presence in Bangor and to strengthen the City’s existing
businesses, emphasizing business retention. 
Chair Leonard asked for Committee questions, and shared he believes the partnership is
in alignment with the Department’s vision.
Councilor Beck asked for an example of how business owners would get connected to the
partnership. Community and Economic Development Director Krieg discussed the
outreach process to the business community, which entails 6-9 months of curating
connections.
Community and Economic Development Director Krieg presented on the AI Hub
collaboration with the University of Maine.
Chair Leonard discussed AI utilization with business cultivation, expressing he believes
that Bangor needs innovations such as this to attract young people. Councilor Fish
expressed excitement surround the partnership.
Councilor Beck commented he would like to explore if there is an opportunity to offer a
pipeline for high school students.
3. Executive Session: Acquisition of real property or economic development 1
M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(C) – 2 items
Councilor Carson moved that, pursuant to 1 M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(C) Acquisition of Real
Property or Economic Development, there are two items to enter into Executive Session.
Seconded by Council Faloon. Roll call vote conducted – all in favor, none opposed. Motion
passed
4. Possible Actions on Executive Session Items
Councilor Carson moved staff recommendation on the sales for 45 Allen Street and 299
Essex Street. Seconded by Councilor Faloon. Vote unless doubted, no doubt.
Meeting adjourned at 5:50 P.M.
Meeting minutes respectfully submitted,
Kayleigh Rienas
Development Assistant
Community & Economic Development Department
